card.summary: A control room for freelancers: time tracking with rates, projects, clients, finances and deadlines. In production as a vanilla JavaScript PWA, with the panel being migrated to React and TypeScript, backed by more than 1,200 unit tests.

meta.title: Snugport · Project · Fritz Reigar
meta.description: A control room for freelancers: a vanilla JavaScript PWA in production and a panel migrating to React and TypeScript, with more than 1,200 tests.

items.text: The production version, in vanilla JavaScript with no dependencies, is an installable PWA that works offline.

An ongoing migration of the panel to React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind 4, alongside production: more than 1,200 unit tests (Vitest), more than 300 E2E tests (Playwright) on mobile and desktop, and mutation testing.

Free, with no account and no limits; the paid plan, a Stripe subscription, syncs your data across devices. Backend on Supabase (Postgres, Auth and Edge Functions in TypeScript): the paywall lives in Postgres RLS policies, not in the client.
